text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text: (――What is a sword?)

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text: (What is a swing worthy of being brandished by a hero?)

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text:
(The blade is unclouded, the point is sharp.
That single streak of silver, straight and unwavering.)

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text:
—Seize it.
—Pierce through...!

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text: Gaaaaaaaahhhh!!

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text:
(Raise the sword!!
Seize it with these hands—the qualification of a hero!!)
(WAAAH!!)

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
choice_data_list: Good work! That was a great race!
Good work! That was a great race!

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text:
...Ah.
Huh, w-what, Trainer...?

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text:
The race... is over, isn't it?
I... ran in the Japan Derby—

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text: ...I couldn't win...

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text:
...Ngh...
I thought I gave it my all.
I really thought I could win...!

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text:
In reality... there are so many more amazing Umamusume out there,
and I'm really not the main character after all...!

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text: ...Still.

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text:
...Even if you can't accomplish it,
you can still dream again.
Isn't that right...?

text_block_list.name: Spectator A
text_block_list.text: Rob Roy! That was so close!

text_block_list.name: Spectator B
text_block_list.text: Thanks for showing us such a great race!

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text:
(...I couldn't win the crown meant for a hero.
Even so—)

text_block_list.name: Spectator A
text_block_list.text: This year's Derby was amazing too!!

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text:
(Because I am inside
the story I yearned for that day.)

Having achieved great results at the Japan Derby,
Zenno Rob Roy was immediately
surrounded by the press!

text_block_list.name: Reporter A
text_block_list.text:
Great work out there, Zenno Rob Roy!
That was a wonderful race...!

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text:
Ah, thank you very much.
Um... I'm sorry for not living up to your expectations.

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text:
"Of course, it's super frustrating...!
But I also feel like I gave it my all...
I just hope I can work even harder toward the next race."

text_block_list.name: Reporter A
text_block_list.text:
I see... Then as expected, does that mean
your next goal is the Kikuka Sho?

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text:
"Y-Yes.
I discussed it with Trainer, and
we decided to use the summer for resting after all—"

text_block_list.name: Reporter A
text_block_list.text:
Lastly... as the Classic campaign continues onward,
how do you plan to fight your way through it?

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text: (...This question—)

text_block_list.name: Reporter A
text_block_list.text:
Zenno Rob Roy, what kind of
Umamusume do you want to become?

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text:
O-Of course!!
Hero...!

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text: (Back then, my sense of shame was locked tight inside a sturdy shell...)

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text: (Coward that I was, I lacked the means to break it, and merely stood waiting for someone to save me.)

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text: (...Still, right now...)

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text: (The sword of courage rests in my hands.)

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text:
(Oh, foolish yet thick shell of shame,
blocking out everything—)

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text: (――Break open!)

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text: Someday, to everyone who watched the race—

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text: —I want to run in a way... that makes everyone acknowledge me as a "hero"...!

Zenno Rob Roy glances over
with just her eyes to check on me.

text_block_list.name: Reporter A
text_block_list.text:
A hero...! I see, an Umamusume who will lead
the racing world into the future—

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text: ...Ehehe.

I see, I thought.
Surely Zenno Rob Roy, after passing
through this "story" that is the Derby—

She was finally able to accept... that she was the protagonist
of a heroic tale, and someone destined to become a hero one day.

Our protagonist, Zenno Rob Roy, sets her sights
next on the Kikuka Sho.
—The race won by the strongest horse girl.
A grand stage fit for a future hero!
